refill.why: Good phrase, but only one USE slot was needed and U01 was picked as the simpler fit
The Korean leaves out the object in 'amdano' (for it/him), so the learner can't tell which Welsh form is wanted
'Why didn't we want to learn Welsh?' is an odd thing to ask about ourselves, so it is a weak phrase
Mixing 'I know' with 'why we didn't want to ask' sounds forced
'We' didn't want to stop because 'I' was enjoying it: the change of person doesn't make sense, and the Korean reads awkwardly
Long and awkward, and 'ei' (his/her) is ambiguous in the Korean
